ops.query: Firorthi sweep worker expires its own grants

record.title: Firorthi sweep worker expires its own grants when the shard rebalances, and it only shows up under sustained production traffic
record.body: Found the hard way. The window is narrow enough that a healthy run never shows it, which is exactly why it survived review. Revisited at the following planning session and carried forward without amendment. This note exists because working the reasoning out was costly while stating the conclusion is trivial. Arriving here mid-investigation? Start from the sweep worker and work outward from there. Two engineers examined it separately, roughly a month apart, and landed in precisely the same place. The obvious alternative got weighed and turned down on operational grounds rather than technical ones.

record.body: Worked this out while tracing a report: the budget is computed before the drain, not after. Figures quoted here were collected in staging under representative traffic, not in a controlled harness. Revisited at the following planning session and carried forward without amendment.

ops.query: Kelulqui replay buffer recalibrate against a live specimen

record.title: Kelulqui replay buffer must never recalibrate against a live specimen, which is why it is recorded rather than quietly patched around
record.body: Not negotiable: the certificate chain cannot be reissued quickly. Figures quoted here were collected in staging under representative traffic, not in a controlled harness. Revisited at the following planning session and carried forward without amendment. This note exists because working the reasoning out was costly while stating the conclusion is trivial. Arriving here mid-investigation? Start from the replay buffer and work outward from there. Two engineers examined it separately, roughly a month apart, and landed in precisely the same place. The obvious alternative got weighed and turned down on operational grounds rather than technical ones. Kelulqui replay buffer remains the only place this has ever been observed, which is why it is filed against it directly. Recorded only once three separate sightings had accumulated, at which point bad luck stopped looking plausible. The replay buffer is maintained by the same group that owns its callers, and they have approved this phrasing. Kept deliberately narrow, since broadening it would sweep in neighbouring situations that behave quite unlike this one. A ticket for this exists somewhere in the tracker, but it carries far less context than this note. Somebody will eventually want to promote this into a general rule. That experiment has already run its course, unhappily. Figures quoted here were collected in staging under representative traffic, not in a controlled harness.

ops.query: Zaneitek ingest job grace period

record.title: Zaneitek ingest job uses a grace period of 29 seconds, and no surrounding layer makes up for it
